text:
Only hole 1 on the Cover is flagged: Ø5.500 is in tolerance but it sits at x -36.00 instead of -39.00, while y matches. A single hole off by a clean 3 mm, with the other holes passing, points to a misplaced feature that the rebuild did not move, not a misread datum. The Base plate already passed against the same interface, so waiving this would put a Cover in assembly whose hole is 3 mm from its mating hole, and the bolt would not go through.

I'm not relaxing the hole check on the Cover. Hole 1 is genuinely 3 mm out in x, and it would not line up with the Base plate. I'm giving Benny one more round with the exact coordinates. Separately, please review IF-01. The brief asks for M6 bolts but the approved interface says M5 with Ø5.5 clearance holes, and the hole positions don't follow from a 120 × 80 plate with an 11 mm inset. The Base plate was built to the same numbers. If you want M6 or edge-inset positions, both plates need the interface changed and a rebuild. That is a major change, so it's your call before I touch it.

Done: Relax the review-round cap on PACL-4 Cover, for 1 more round. Relaxed (not passed) for 1 more round. PACL-4 went back to work. (The round cap is procedural; one more round with a precise instruction is honest work on a fixable part; a minor step, so I did it myself. It is in the Archie log.)

Done: Relax the no-progress guard on PACL-4 Cover, for 1 more round. Relaxed (not passed) for 1 more round. (The rebuild didn't move the hole because the instruction wasn't specific enough, not because the measurement is wrong; a minor step, so I did it myself. It is in the Archie log.)

Done: Send PACL-4 Cover back to its designer: Move hole 1 (IF-01) so its centre is exactly at x = -39.00, y = -24.00 in the part frame; it is currently at x = -36.00. Keep it Ø5.5 through. Hole 1 on the Cover measures Ø5.500 at (-36.00, -24.00) against a specified (-39.00, -24.00), and only that hole is off. Diameter, y-position and the other three holes conform, so the check is reading the part correctly: a single asymmetric hole looks like a model error, not a measurement fault. Benny was told to move it to x = -39.00 and it did not move, so the fix is a fresh pair of hands with the same exact instruction, not relaxing a geometry check that would hide a bolt that won't go through.

The Cover has one bolt hole 3 mm out of place in x, and the rebuild didn't move it. The check looks right to me, so I'm not waiving it: a waived hole there means a bolt that won't go in. I've handed the Cover to Molly with an exact position for that hole and given it one more review round. Separately, your brief says M6 bolts, but the approved interface is M5 with 5.5 mm holes, and its hole pattern doesn't match the 11 mm edge inset it lists. If you want M6, that's a major change, because the Base plate and bolt are already integrated against M5. Tell me and I'll propose the interface change.

Done: Reassign PACL-4 Cover to Molly. PACL-4 now goes to Molly. (Benny's rebuild left hole 1 exactly where it was after an explicit instruction, so a different designer is the fair next step.; a minor step, so I did it myself. It is in the Archie log.)

Done: Send PACL-4 Cover back to its designer: In the Cover's part frame (origin at plate centre), hole 1 is at x = -36.00, y = -24.00; delete it and re-cut it as Ø5.5 through at exactly x = -39.00, y = -24.00. Check that all four holes then sit at (+39, +24), (-39, +24), (+39, -24), (-39, -24), matching the Base plate. Change no other feature.. PACL-4 went back to Molly with the instruction. (A precise, single-feature fix to the measured fault.; a minor step, so I did it myself. It is in the Archie log.)

IF-01 does not match the brief: the brief calls for M6 bolts, but IF-01 specifies M5 with Ø5.5 holes. Its inset of 11.0 on a 120 x 80 plate would put the holes at (±49, ±29), not the (±39, ±24) Gage measures against. The reading is not clearly a gauge error, because only hole 1 is off and it has read Ø5.500 at x = -36.00 across seven builds and two explicit move instructions, so relaxing conformance could hide a real 3 mm mismatch against an already integrated Base plate.

I've paused the Cover. The bolted-joint interface IF-01 conflicts with the brief: it specifies M5 bolts in Ø5.5 holes where the brief asks for M6, and its 11 mm inset doesn't match the ±39 / ±24 hole pattern being checked. On top of that, Cover hole 1 keeps measuring 3 mm off at x = -36. I don't want to relax this check, because that could ship a cover whose holes don't line up with the Base plate. My proposal: correct IF-01 to M6 with Ø6.6 clearance holes and one hole pattern that agrees with the inset, then confirm the Base plate's actual hole positions before the Cover is rebuilt against it. Since the Base plate is already done, this means reopening it, so I need your approval before changing the interface.

Done: Pause PACL-4 Cover. PACL-4 is paused. (Rebuilds keep repeating the same result; IF-01 contradicts the brief and needs the engineer's decision before honest work can continue, and relaxing conformance could hide a real hole misalignment.; a minor step, so I did it myself. It is in the Archie log.)
